corrections.reason: The standard Andemta citation marker 'እንዲል' is printed with the 3rd-order 'ዲ', which was misread as 4th-order 'ዳ'.
The printed word has only three glyphs ('እጆቿ'); Stage 1 hallucinated an extra 'ዋ' at the end.
Completing 'ጆሮቿ' from L11, only the single character 'ቿ' is printed at the start of L12 without an extra 'ዋ'.
In the proverb 'አማጭ ለልማዱ የበቅሎ ከበድ የሐር ገመድ አለኝ ይላልና', the glyph is clearly 2nd-order 'ዱ' with the right-side hook.
The word wrapping onto L18 ('ይሆን') is 'ባይሆን'; the glyph at the end of L17 is 4th-order 'ባ' with a shorter right leg.
The 3rd-person feminine singular verb is 'ቆየች' ('she waited'); the middle character is 1st-order 'የ' without a top-right loop.
The printed text is '፯ቱ' ('the seven [words]'), referring to the seven Ge'ez words of Gabriel's salutation that follow on L36–39 ('ተፈሥሒ ፍሥሕት ኦምልዕተ ጸጋ ቡርክት አንቲ እምአንስት ወቡሩክ ፍሬ ከርሥኪ').
Because '፯ቱ' on L35 is the Amharic commentary introducing the seven words, the opening quote marker '⟪' belongs before 'ተፈሥሒ'.
